name: Shikimi Sekai
source: Even though he seems to be related to one of the students, he doesn't show it and only interacts with him as a teacher. He's gentle and kind to everyone and always has a gentle smile on his face. Although he's not in charge of any classes, he puts his heart into keeping students healthy, both mentally and physically.
